title: Top-3 Maximum Tracker
constraints: Track the three largest values seen since reset (duplicates count separately), sorted: `t0 ≥ t1 ≥ t2`. Reset sets all three to 0.
Each rising edge with `valid = 1` inserts `din` into the sorted list and drops the smallest.
hints: Compare `din` with t0, t1 and t2 in parallel. The results tell you where it slots in.
Insert at position 0: shift everything down. Position 1: t2 ← t1, t1 ← din. Position 2: t2 ← din. Otherwise no change.
Use `>` (not `≥`) for the comparisons so that equal values keep their order. Either works here, since equal values are indistinguishable.
